quote: The amendment made by subsection (a) shall take effect 12 months after the date of enactment of this Act. Such effective date shall be with respect to the date of manufacture
why: Sec. 204(b) delays the rewritten smokeless tobacco warning section to 12 months after the June 22, 2009 enactment and keys it to products manufactured on or after that date (sec. 205's later amendment has no timing provision).

quote: The amendment made by subsection (a) shall apply to claims for credit or refund for taxable years ending after the date of the enactment of this Act.
why: Sec. 1282(b) limits the 6512(b)(3) amendment to claims for taxable years ending after the Aug 5, 1997 enactment; the other 6512 amendments are likewise forward-looking (sec. 1239: partnership taxable years ending after enactment; sec. 1451(c): effective on enactment).
No amendment of 16 U.S.C. 1432 or any timing provision covering one was found in the law text, so it defaults to the Sept 30, 1996 approval date.

quote: this title and the amendments made by this title shall take effect or are deemed to have taken effect, as appropriate, on the earlier of-- (1) the date of the enactment of this title; or (2) September 30, 2001.
why: Sec. 603 deems sec. 632's amendment of section 8(t)(2) effective Sept 30, 2001, before the Jan 10, 2002 enactment, and the amendment itself covers mortgage prepayments and insurance terminations during fiscal year 1996 or thereafter.

quote: shall take effect upon the expiration of the 30-day period beginning on the date of the enactment of this Act; and (2) shall apply to-- (A) any action that is commenced in a United States district court on or after such effective date
why: Sec. 205 makes the venue amendments effective 30 days after the Dec 7, 2011 enactment and applies them only to actions commenced (or removed actions begun in state court) on or after that date.
The customs user fee amendments in sec. 2004(f) have no effective-date or applicability provision, so they take effect on the Dec 3, 2004 approval date.

quote: Except as provided in section 14(c), this Act and the amendments made by this Act shall apply to any forfeiture proceeding commenced on or after the date that is 120 days after the date of the enactment of this Act.
why: Sec. 21 limits the CAFRA amendments, including those to 21 U.S.C. 881, to forfeiture proceedings commenced on or after 120 days after the Apr 25, 2000 enactment.

quote: The amendments made by this section shall apply to sales after September 30, 2005.
why: Most 6427 amendments apply only to sales, uses or removals after future dates (sec. 11161-11162: after Sept 30, 2005; sec. 11163: after Dec 31, 2005; sec. 11113: after Sept 30, 2006), though sec. 11151(a)'s technical strike of 6427(f) and (o) is effective as if included in the American Jobs Creation Act of 2004.
The amendment to section 201 of the Fur Seal Act of 1966 (striking "on such Islands") has no timing provision covering it, so it takes effect on the Dec 21, 2000 approval date.

quote: Except as provided in subsection (b), this Act shall take effect 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act. (b) ... Sections 7 and 8 shall take effect one year after the date of the enactment of this Act.
why: Sec. 12 delays the FOIA amendments to 180 days after the Oct 2, 1996 enactment (sections 7 and 8 to one year after), with no reach back.
